source.name: A dialog created with keyboard: false must stay open however often Escape is pressed
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43070) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Escape must not dismiss a dialog opened with keyboard: false
journey.goal: The confirmation dialog stays open however often Escape is pressed, so the user can still enter the code and send the transfer

functionalJourney.title: Confirm with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking the backdrop does not close the dialog; entering the code and clicking Send completes the transfer

guards.title: Cancel transfer still closes the dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Tabbing to Cancel transfer and pressing Enter closes the dialog and records the cancellation

plan.root_cause: The dialog’s Escape key handling relies solely on the native cancel event. When CSS transitions are disabled, the backdrop transition callback may not run, leaving the cancel listener in a state where it does not prevent the default action on subsequent Escape presses, allowing the dialog to close.
plan.repair_strategy: Add an early Escape keydown check in _addDialogListeners that prevents default and returns immediately when keyboard is false, ensuring Escape never triggers dialog closure regardless of the cancel listener’s state.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can press Escape repeatedly without accidentally closing the confirmation dialog, keeping focus in the OTP field and allowing them to enter the code and send the transfer.
functional_risks: No functional regression for dialogs with keyboard:true (Escape still closes via cancel).
No impact on non‑modal dialogs (existing keydown logic unchanged).
Cancel button and backdrop click behavior remain unchanged.
verification_requirements: Press Escape any number of times while the dialog is open; dialog must remain open and focus must stay in the OTP field.
Press Escape when keyboard:true; dialog must close and focus return to the trigger button.
Press Tab and Enter to navigate and submit the OTP; behavior unchanged.
Clicking the Cancel transfer button must close the dialog and set status to 'Cancelled'.
Clicking the Send button with a six‑digit code must set status to 'Sent' and close the dialog.
